name: Home Assistant Dashboard
headline: Your Smart Home at a Glance
description:
A customizable Home Assistant dashboard for Stream Deck. View selected real-time entity values, compact multi-entity overviews and observed sensor trends, with domain-checked smart-home controls and scene/script shortcuts. Stream Deck+ gets a brightness dial for supported lights, and Neo can show a display-only household Infobar. Includes editable unconfigured MK.2, XL, Plus and Neo profile templates. Requires a reachable Home Assistant instance and a user-provided long-lived access token. Windows support only until additional platforms are verified. Device capabilities and availability vary.

Security note: your Home Assistant access token is stored in Stream Deck plugin global settings, not the operating-system credential vault. Treat it like your Home Assistant account credential and keep your computer account protected.
release_notes: Initial candidate: shared live Home Assistant connection with entity status, observed sensor history and multi-entity overviews. Supported light/switch controls and scene/script triggers with acknowledgements. Editable major-model profile templates plus Stream Deck+ brightness dial and Neo display-only Infobar.
